Laura / Marcus,

Forwarding the remittance and bank trace from Steadfast. The remittance lists invoice-level amounts (attached) but the bank trace shows one consolidated credit into our virtual collection account. We need to decide posting strategy so that:

- Each invoice posts to the correct Redwood legal entity (we have three: Redwood US Inc., Redwood EU S.à r.l., Redwood UK Ltd).
- VAT is split between the EU entity and the UK invoice lines correctly (Ellie flagged that some invoices include VAT charged at 20% for the UK reseller).

Preliminary notes from my side:
- The total matches the invoices Ellie listed.
- The remittance indicates ST-INV-9842 and ST-INV-9851 are for services sold to the UK entity (VAT applies).
- If we post using the bank trace alone we'll end up with an unapplied cash pool of USD 186,420.73 which then requires internal reallocation journal entries. I'd prefer to apply by invoice if we can match amounts exactly.

Can you confirm:
1) Whether Finance can process a split posting using the remittance as the source of truth (we'll attach the PDF to each payment posting).
2) Whether you need the NatWest trace converted into a CSV for the AR system (I can export from the trace file).

I've attached a quick workup of how the total would break by entity and VAT buckets — see redwood_vat_workup_20261130.xlsx. If you confirm, I'll mark the invoices as posted and close the AR items.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Thanks Vanessa — reviewed the remittance and our VAT workup. Finance can post using the remittance as the allocation source. Action plan:

1) Laura will import the NatWest trace converted to CSV and create a single cash receipt for USD 186,420.73 into the virtual account GL.
2) We will create three disbursement journal entries to move amounts from the virtual account to each legal entity clearing account, matching the invoice-level amounts from the remittance.
3) VAT treatment: we'll book VAT output for UK-invoice lines at 20% and move those VAT amounts to the UK VAT payable ledger. The remainder goes to the EU VAT bucket as per the attached workbook.
4) We will upload the steadfast_remittance_20261130.pdf to the invoice postings in the AR system for audit trail.

Laura — can you confirm you have access to the shared Drive folder (link below) and that you can complete the import before EOD tomorrow? Once posted, Vanessa, please mark the AR items as cleared.
